Organ parts, spinal cord, patellar ligament, mammary gland, eye, skin and brain regions: Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Object Library, HuBMAP Consortium (CC BY 4.0), with brain regions from the Allen Human Reference Atlas. Inner ear and ear canal: OpenEar library of 3D models of the human temporal bone (Sieber, Erfurt, John, Ribeiro dos Santos, Schurzig, Sørensen, Lenarz; Sci Data 2018, doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.297; CC BY 4.0) and IE-Map, a human inner-ear atlas and template (Ahmadi, Raiser, Ruehl, Flanagin, zu Eulenburg; Sci Rep 2021, doi:10.1038/s41598-021-82716-0; CC BY 4.0; surfaces derived from David et al. 2016 and Wimmer et al. 2019, both CC BY 4.0); modified: decimated, registered onto this body, left ear mirrored from the right. Additional coronary, cardiac, hepatic, portal, bowel, pelvic and retinal vessels: Human Reference Atlas (CC BY 4.0). Derived meshes in this pack are released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Schematic stand-ins (group "schematic") are generated by this project from the positions of real neighbouring structures; they are indicative only, are not scans or measured anatomy, and are never counted as real anatomy.

groups.title: Real meshes for former stand-ins
groups.description: Real meshes replacing stand-ins in the core pack.

groups.title: Muscles and tendons
groups.description: Every named muscle, muscle head and tendon in the reference set.

groups.title: Organ parts and small structures
groups.description: Lung lobes and bronchi, liver segments and ducts, pancreatic parts, bowel segments, renal calyces and pyramids, cardiac chambers and valves, larynx, tongue, eye, glands and reproductive structures.

groups.title: Lymph nodes and lymphoid organs
groups.description: Named lymph node groups, tonsils and thymic lobes.

groups.title: Nerves, plexuses and ganglia
groups.description: Cranial nerves, spinal nerve roots, brachial and lumbosacral plexuses, named limb nerves, sympathetic trunk and ganglia.

groups.title: Arteries
groups.description: Named arteries from the aorta to the digital branches.

groups.title: Fascia, bursae and tendon sheaths
groups.description: Named deep fasciae, intermuscular septa, bursae and tendon sheaths.

groups.title: Veins and sinuses
groups.description: Named veins, venous plexuses and dural sinuses.

groups.title: Joints and ligaments
groups.description: Ligaments, joint capsules, articular discs, menisci and labra.

groups.title: Skeleton
groups.description: Every named bone, tooth and cartilage: vertebrae, ribs, carpals, tarsals, phalanges, skull bones, ossicles and costal cartilages.

groups.title: Skin layers
groups.description: Schematic dermis and hypodermis shells, real abdominal subcutaneous fat patches, hair, nails and eyelashes.

groups.title: Brain regions
groups.description: Allen Human Reference Atlas regions: cortical gyri, basal ganglia, thalamic nuclei, cerebellum and ventricles.

groups.title: Inner ear and ear canal
groups.description: Real CC BY 4.0 research-scan meshes: cochlear scalae, round window, external acoustic meatus (OpenEar) and membranous labyrinth: semicircular ducts, ampullae, utricle, saccule, cochlear duct (IE-Map). Registered onto the Z-Anatomy ossicles; the left ear is the right ear mirrored.

groups.title: Schematic stand-ins (generated, not real anatomy)
groups.description: Spinal nerves C1–Co1, cervical, lumbar and sacral plexuses, autonomic plexuses and ganglia, vagus, phrenic and splanchnic branches, third molars, small vessel branches, joint capsules and cartilage, sutures, and gap-fill placeholders (metopic suture, umbilical remnants, pleural cavities, fibrous pericardium, peritoneal sheets, nipples, and a representative inset of skin appendages). Drawn in violet from the positions of real structures; indicative courses only.
